runtime.note: No compiled runtime. bash 5+ and the coreutils below are the whole dependency.

commands.name: bash
commands.why: the engine is bash; 5.0+ for associative arrays and ${var@Q}

commands.name: grep
commands.why: config and blueprint parsing throughout

commands.name: sed
commands.why: config rewriting and template substitution

commands.name: awk
commands.why: field extraction in status, port and process paths

commands.name: find
commands.why: instance and blueprint discovery

commands.name: yq
commands.why: unified blueprints are .bp.yaml — this is the parser
commands.warning: must be the Go yq. Debian's yq is an unrelated Python tool with incompatible syntax; a name-only check passes and blueprint parsing then fails as if the YAML were corrupt.

commands.name: jq
commands.why: every JSON-emitting command and the event journal

commands.name: curl
commands.why: version checks and downloads against upstream APIs

commands.name: wget
commands.why: server-file downloads in the native install path

commands.name: tar
commands.why: backup create/restore

commands.name: unzip
commands.why: unpacking zip-distributed game servers

commands.name: rsync
commands.why: backup capture and instance file sync

commands.name: sha256sum
commands.why: backup manifest integrity

commands.name: ss
commands.why: listening-port checks for instance status

commands.name: lsof
commands.why: resolving which process holds an instance port

commands.name: systemctl
commands.why: lifecycle for systemd-managed instances

commands.name: openssl
commands.why: HMAC-signs the payload of an outgoing event webhook

commands.name: pgrep
commands.why: walks a native instance's child processes when stopping it

commands.name: diff
commands.why: config diff against a configuration backup

commands.name: steamcmd
commands.why: install and update Steam-distributed game servers
commands.without: non-Steam games install normally; Steam blueprints fail at install

commands.name: docker
commands.why: container-kind instances
commands.without: the container templates refuse to load; native instances are unaffected

commands.name: docker-compose
commands.why: multi-service container instances

commands.name: ufw
commands.why: host firewall rules when enable_firewall_management=true
commands.without: ports are never opened or closed by the engine

commands.name: tput
commands.why: coloured terminal output
commands.without: output is plain; nothing else changes

commands.name: nc
commands.why: probes whether a port is reachable from outside the host
commands.without: the check falls back to telnet, and reports the port as unverified when neither is present

commands.name: telnet
commands.why: the fallback for the same external-reachability probe

system.why: native instances are supervised in cgroups by kgsm-watchdog
system.without: container and systemd instance kinds still work

units.note: The retention pair are system units running as the KGSM account. setup.sh installs them to /etc/systemd/system/ and enables the timer; the package installs them to /usr/lib/systemd/system/ and presets the timer in post_install, so a node runs retention with nobody enabling it.
